card.name: Partway through drug and enzyme names
card.fires_on: Partway through a longer drug or enzyme name in drug-label text, such as the letter after CYP2, the middle of colestipol hydrochloride, or the start of a brand name. It also fires on endings of words like perforation and overdosage.

modes.label: Enzyme letters
modes.description: The single letter after CYP2 in an enzyme name.
modes.example: For those CYP2<<C>>19 substrate drugs that require therapeutic monitoring

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: The middle or start of a drug or brand name, such as hydro in hydrochloride.
modes.example: Repeated doses of colestipol<< hydro>>chloride given prior to a single dose

modes.label: Word endings
modes.description: The last piece of a long medical noun like perforation or overdosage.
modes.example: Risk Factors for GI Bleeding, Ulceration, and Perfor<<ation>> Patients with a prior history of pe

card.writes: It seems to suppress list-introducing words like 'such as' and 'various', which fits a word still being completed.
card.plain: It fires when a long drug, enzyme or medical term is only partly written out and the rest of the word is still to come.
